title: Riverside Public Library: Changes to Opening Hours
L: Beginning April 1, the Riverside Public Library will extend its opening hours on weekdays.
The library will open at 8:00 A.M. instead of 9:00 A.M., giving visitors an extra hour each morning.
Closing time on weekdays will not change.
Weekend hours will remain the same.
These changes were made in response to a survey of library users.
Many of them said they wanted to study before work.
In addition, the library will add more study tables on the second floor.

exq.why: Mở cửa sớm hơn, thêm một giờ mỗi sáng → kéo dài giờ mở cửa: extend.

exq.a: Closing time on weekdays will not change.
w: The library building is more than fifty years old.
Visitors can borrow up to ten books at a time.
The survey was sent to visitors by e-mail.
exq.why: Câu trước nói giờ mở cửa ngày thường; câu chèn nói giờ đóng cửa ngày thường không đổi, rồi mới tới giờ cuối tuần.
Câu sau có Many of them said… → cần danh từ chỉ người: library users.
